description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'CurrenciesHelper' that provides methods for interacting with currencies in the Fineract API. It contains methods to retrieve all currencies, retrieve selected currencies, get a currency by code, and update selected currencies, primarily used for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: CurrenciesHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing currency-related API interactions during integration testing.

methods.name: getAllCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves all available currencies from the server, combining selected and available options. Deprecated.

methods.name: getSelectedCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches only the selected currencies from the server. Deprecated.

methods.name: getCurrencybyCode
methods.description: Finds and returns a currency object matching the specified code from the list of all currencies. Deprecated.

methods.name: updateSelectedCurrencies
methods.description: Updates the list of selected currencies on the server. Deprecated.

methods.name: currenciesToJSON
methods.description: Converts a list of currency codes into a JSON string for API submission. Private helper method.
